name: uc-bridge
description: uc-bridge (agent-JJ-turnstile): 采集引擎 5 级 CF Turnstile 反反爬策略链的 L2/L3 级 —— undetected-chromedriver(UC) + pyvirtualdisplay(xvfb)。引擎 obscura.bypassTurnstile() 在 cfg.turnstileBypass=true 且 captchaType='turnstile' 时调用本桥 POST /fetch(?xvfb=1 启用 L3)。仅绑 127.0.0.1:3016, 鉴权/限速/SSRF/安全头/30s 超时同其他桥。安装: python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; Chrome 见 README.md (Playwright Chromium 已含或 apt install google-chrome-stable)

scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python server.py; else exec python3 server.py; fi'
scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python server.py; else exec python3 server.py; fi'
